title: Project Manager (AI)
description:
Job Title - Project Manager (AI)
Location - Remote (EST Hours)
Duration - 12+ Months

Duties:

What you can expect:
As the IT PMO (Project Management Office) Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and governing enterprise IT projects and assigned programs to ensure delivery of approved scope, schedule, budget and quality outcomes.
Operating within a framework of excellence, collaboration, and innovation, you will apply PMO standards and methodologies to ensure alignment with organizational goals and focus areas. This role provides the opportunity to contribute directly to the organization's mission by enabling reliable and compliant IT delivery.
Planned work hours/time zone: Eastern, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
Unplanned work hours anticipated: Nights and weekends as needed for project delivery and deployments.
Sit or stand, type, mouse, and talk for most of the workday.
Fluently read, write, and verbally communicate in English

*This role will be the 2nd position focused on AI and Data Strategy Implementation. Looking for a candidate who can identify and manage the use cases of AI by bringing in the right functional leaders together and organizing the work to bring out AI Features and Processes. Must have great communication skills, agile thinking, organizational skills and be able to communicate complex problems in a simplified manner. Project governance experience is a plus.

How you will create impact:
The IT PMO Project Manager contributes to global IT delivery success by ensuring disciplined execution, transparency, and risk management across assigned projects and programs.

Strategic Leadership:
Execute projects in alignment with established PMO strategies, policies, and procedures.
Provide project-level leadership and guidance to teams, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities.
Champion a culture of delivery excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement within assigned projects and IT PMO.
Project Program Management:
Manage and govern large, complex IT projects and assigned programs in accordance with PMO standards.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
Monitor project progress, dependencies, resource usage, and financial performance; identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues as needed.
Resolve project-related issues and risks and obtain alignment between stakeholders.
Ensure that IT projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, and in compliance with quality, security, and regulatory requirements.
Stakeholder Engagement and Relationship Management:
Build and maintain effective working relationships with business and IT stakeholders.
Provide clear, concise status reporting, risk visibility, and delivery recommendations to stakeholders and sponsors.
Facilitate regular project communication, governance reviews, and decision forums.
Resource Management and Talent Development:
Lead cross-functional, matrixed project teams, assigning work and tracking delivery commitments.
Coordinate resource needs and timing with functional managers.
Support the development of less experienced project team members through guidance and best-practice knowledge sharing.
Quality Assurance and Process Improvement:
Apply and adhere to established PMO project management methodologies and quality controls.
Ensure required project documentation and artifacts are maintained and audit-ready.
Participate in post-project reviews to identify lessons learned and improvement opportunities
Skills:    
What makes you stand out:
Strong project leadership and execution skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination abilities.
Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional IT projects.
Ability to proactively identify risks and resolve issues to maintain project momentum.

Education: 
Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in IT project management or related roles. Associate's degree and 8+ years in IT project management, program leadership, or related roles, or High School Diploma/Equivalent and 10+ years in IT project management, program leadership, or related roles.
Preferred background:
Bachelor's degree in information technology, Business Administration, or related field and Master's degree.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent
Experience in healthcare, medical devices, biotech, or regulated environments.
Travel expectations:
Over the course of a normal year, you can expect up to 15% travel, domestic and/or international.

title: Quality Inspector Temp
description:
Quality Inspector I (Temporary)
Location: Englewood CO 80112
Department: Quality Lab
Position Type: 100% Onsite

About the Company
The Client is a global medical technology leader. Team members are part of a company with a heritage of leadership, focused on shaping the future and dedicated to alleviating pain and improving the quality of life for people around the world.
About the Role
The Client is focused on orthopedic medical devices for the foot and ankle, is hiring a Quality Inspector I (Temporary) to join the Quality Lab.
The Quality Inspector I is responsible for:
  • Inspection of materials, assemblies, work-in-progress, and finished medical devices
  • Completing documentation to determine conformance to specifications
  • Releasing product for distribution and use
This is a 100% onsite position located in Englewood, Colorado.
Job Responsibilities
  1. Perform receiving inspection of materials, work-in-progress, finished parts, and assemblies, including completion of associated paperwork for final product release.
  2. Conduct visual inspections according to documented specifications.
  3. Measure product features per documented specifications and inspection checklists.
  4. Generate accurate documentation of measured characteristics for non-conforming products and properly identify products according to procedures.
  5. Monitor calibration status of inspection equipment.
  6. Additional responsibilities may include:
    • Product labeling and packaging as needed
    • Verifying, scanning, and filing documents
    • Assisting with identifying product status and organizing products
    • Other duties as assigned
Qualifications
  • High school diploma plus 1–2 years of quality experience preferred
  • Associate degree preferred
  • Experience with dimensional measurement equipment such as:
    • Micrometers
    • Calipers
    • Gage pins
    • Dial indicators
  • Knowledge and experience with precision measuring equipment such as:
    • CMM
    • Vision Systems
  • Basic understanding of print reading and GD&T per ASME Y14.5
  • Familiarity with:
    • 21 CFR 820
    • ISO 13485
    • Other government/ISO standards preferred
  • Ability to follow standard operating procedures
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work with small components
  • Good handwriting and communication skills
  • Basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel)
  • Knowledge of machined components is a plus

title: Quality Senior Engineer I
description:
Job Title - Quality Senior Engineer I
Location - Englewood CO 80112

Description:

Job Title
Quality Senior Engineer I
Duties

Education

title: Account Executive II
description:
Title: Account Manager
Duration: 1 year with possible extension
Location: Remote

Role Summary
Goldmind’s Account Manager (Consultant) serves as the primary day-to-day client partner and internal lead for creative development work, functioning at the level of an external agency Account Supervisor.
This role partners closely with client Consumer Engagement & Brand, COEs (Centers of Excellence) and cross-functional teams to move work from initial request for estimate/timing through final delivery—ensuring approved scopes of work, clear briefs, tight communication, strong collaboration, and on-time, on-strategic project output across multiple channels (Ex. email, PPT presentations, video, collateral, graphics, and other creative assets).

Key Responsibilities
Client Partnership & Account Leadership
Serve as the day-to-day client contact for assigned workstreams, building trusted relationships and enabling productive collaboration.
Lead client conversations to uncover business needs, objectives, audience considerations, success metrics, and key inputs.
Manage client feedback and revisions, translating input into clear direction for internal teams while protecting scope, strategy, and timelines.
Set and manage expectations on timing, deliverables, dependencies, and approvals; proactively flag risks and provide options.
Creative Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Creative, Motion, Design, Copy, Project Management, and Operations to deliver high-quality work across formats including:
Email and digital communications
PPT presentations (executive-ready storytelling and design)
Video and motion assets
Print/digital collateral, sales support materials, and graphics
Ensure briefs are clear and complete (objective, audience, mandatories, tone, deliverables, timelines, approvers, and required inputs).
Facilitate client reviews, consolidate feedback for internal reviews, and drive clear next steps to keep work moving.
Act as an advocate for both client needs and Goldmind quality standards; help teams deliver smart, effective creative solutions.
Workflow, Scope & Delivery Management
Own collaboration with internal team on project estimate/SOW and timeline through scope approval—confirm requirements, align on deliverables, and coordinate schedules in partnership with Project Management.
Maintain visibility into status across deliverables; ensure milestones and approvals are met.
Identify out-of-scope requests and partner with appropriate leads to reset expectations or initiate scope updates.
Ensure deliverables meet brand/quality standards and are packaged appropriately for final handoff.

Required Qualifications
5–8+ years of account management experience in a creative agency or in-house agency environment (Senior Account Manager/Account Supervisor level).
Demonstrated experience managing multi-channel creative development (email, presentations, video/motion, collateral, digital/print assets).
Strong client management skills: briefing, expectation-setting, presenting work, handling feedback, and guiding revisions.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with creative, motion, project management, and operations.
Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), with the ability to translate business needs into actionable creative direction.
Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple projects, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience working within a regulated or highly matrixed organization.
Familiarity with creative workflows and production processes (review cycles, routing, versioning, legal/compliance considerations where applicable).
Ability to read performance or business insights and translate them into stronger creative direction.
Proficiency with common workflow tools (e.g., Workfront) and experience with Generative AI (e.g. OpenAI)

Core Competencies / Success Factors
Client-first partnership with the ability to challenge constructively and advocate for great work
Clarity and precision in briefs, feedback, and next steps
Operational rigor (timelines, dependencies, approvals, risk management)
Creative sensibility and understanding of how strong strategy shows up in execution
Cross-functional leadership without direct authority; strong facilitation skills
Adaptability across work types and pace changes

Teaming
Partners closely with: Portfolio Account Lead, Creative, Motion, Design, Copy, Project Management, Operations, and COE stakeholders

title: Quality Assurance Specialist II
description:
Job title : GRC Program Manager
Location : Remote
Duration: 1 year with possible extension

Must Haves:
1.- Tools ServiceNow and/or CMDB (Must)
2.- Risk Management
3.- Program Manager

Job Description:
GRC Program Manager to partner closely with ServiceNow Delivery Operations and CMDB teams to enable the successful implementation and ongoing transformation of ServiceNow and the CMDB. This role will embed risk management and "governance by design” into delivery—helping ensure the platform, data, processes, and operating model meet regulatory expectations, internal standards, and audit requirements while supporting speed and quality of execution.

Responsibilities
Partner with ServiceNow Delivery Operations and CMDB stakeholders to integrate risk management into the platform implementation and continuous improvement roadmap.
Establish and drive a governance-by-design approach for ServiceNow and CMDB (controls, standards, approvals, and guardrails built into delivery processes).
Perform risk assessments for ServiceNow/CMDB initiatives (scope changes, integrations, data migration, releases), documenting risks, mitigations, owners, and dates to closure.
Define and facilitate governance forums (steering/working groups) to review risk posture, key decisions, exception requests, and delivery readiness.
Build and maintain a risk register for the ServiceNow/CMDB program, including dependencies, key control gaps, and remediation plans.
Support development of strong CMDB risk practices, including data quality controls, lifecycle governance, ownership (RACI), and critical configuration item (CI) standards.
Assess and monitor risks across key areas such as: access management, segregation of duties, change/release management, SDLC controls, data integrity, resiliency/DR, vendor risk, and interface/integration controls.
Create clear executive reporting (KRIs/KPIs) for platform and data risk: data completeness/accuracy, reconciliation outcomes, stale/aging CIs, unauthorized changes, control exceptions, overdue remediation items.
Coordinate with Cybersecurity, IT Risk, Compliance, and Audit (1LoD/2LoD alignment) to ensure requirements are understood and evidenced without slowing delivery.
Support audit and exam readiness for ServiceNow/CMDB by maintaining traceable documentation, decisions, and evidence of control execution.
Help mature operating procedures and playbooks for ongoing transformation (release gates, risk acceptance, exception management, control testing cadence).

Success Measures
Measurable reduction in high/critical risks and aging remediation items tied to ServiceNow/CMDB delivery.
Improved CMDB data quality (completeness, accuracy, timeliness) and reduced unauthorized/incorrect CI changes.
Consistent execution of delivery governance (controls embedded in intake, release, and operational processes).
Improved audit/exam outcomes through strong evidence, clear decisioning, and sustained control operation.
Higher stakeholder confidence and transparency through actionable, timely risk reporting.

title: Window Server Upgrade
description:
Title: Window Server Upgrade
Location - Lutz, FL
Shift Timing: Monday - Friday 8 AM -5 PM EST
Duration: 8-12 month contract


Highschool diploma and Experience required

Complete Description:
Core Windows Server Upgrade Skills
- Proven experience performing in‐place upgrades from Windows Server 2016 to 2019 and/or 2022
- Strong understanding of Windows Server upgrade paths, edition compatibility, and licensing implications
- Ability to assess and remediate pre‐upgrade blockers (deprecated roles, drivers, legacy applications)
- Hands‐on experience reviewing and resolving setupact.log / setuperr.log issues
- Knowledge of supported .NET, PowerShell, and role dependencies across Windows Server versions
- Experience validating post‐upgrade OS health (services, roles, performance, event logs) VMware vSphere & Virtual Machine Operations
- Experience working with VMware vSphere / ESXi virtual machines

 Ability to safely perform:
- VM snapshots (pre‐upgrade and rollback planning)
- Disk space checks and expansion if required
- VMware Tools verification and upgrades
- Understanding of vCPU, memory, and virtual hardware compatibility with newer Windows Server versions
Pre‐Upgrade Planning & Risk Mitigation

 Ability to:
- Run and interpret Windows Upgrade Readiness checks
- Verify application and vendor support for target OS
- Confirm backup validity and recovery options
- Experience documenting:
- Upgrade plans
- Rollback procedures
- Success criteria and validation steps
- Familiarity with change management and maintenance window execution

Application & Role Awareness
- Experience upgrading servers with common roles such as:
- Active Directory Domain Services (non‐FSMO or with coordination)
- DNS / DHCP
- IIS
- File & Print Services
- SQL Server (OS upgrade support validation)
- Ability to identify workloads not suited for in‐place upgrade and recommend alternatives

Security & Compliance Considerations
- Understanding of TLS, cipher, and security baseline changes between Server 2016 and newer versions

Ability to validate:
- Antivirus / EDR compatibility post‐upgrade
- GPO and local policy behavior after upgrade
